clue.text: Ruddy good fellow, but not Oxbridge material

parts.note: ruddy means red in colour
a brick is old slang for a dependable, good-hearted person

explanation.surface: A rosy-cheeked decent chap who would never pass muster at Oxford or Cambridge.
explanation.walkthrough: A redbrick university is one of Britain's newer civic universities, contrasted with ancient Oxford and Cambridge; 'material' plays on bricks as building stuff.
explanation.definitionFit: Redbrick describes the Victorian civic universities, set against the old Oxbridge colleges in British usage.

clue.text: WWII Field Marshal gains military medal in new role

indicators.note: the outer letters take in the medal letters
new signals that these letters take a new form

parts.note: MM is the abbreviation for the Military Medal

explanation.surface: A wartime commander is decorated in his new posting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns ROLE into ROEL, which 'gains' MM.
explanation.definitionFit: Erwin Rommel was a German field marshal of the Second World War, the Desert Fox.
Discharging means firing a weapon and also releasing or unloading a cargo or load.

parts.note: re means concerning
AM is morning, and the possessive s is kept

explanation.surface: A remark about today's newspapers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'papers' suggests newspapers; it means sheets of paper by the ream.
explanation.definitionFit: Reams are large quantities of paper sheets, so the plural fits papers.

parts.note: a house you pull behind a car rather than one you head back to

explanation.definitionFit: A trailer dwelling pulled behind a car is a mobile home on wheels.

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, abbreviated AB for able seaman
a way is a road

explanation.surface: A sailor sets off on his journey to foreign parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe being in or going to a foreign country.

parts.note: reads like a jobseeker begging, but describes a lawyer whose work is pleading cases

explanation.definitionFit: A courtroom advocate argues cases professionally, pleading for clients as a living.

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over the second

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Putting in extra hours to stage a production.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overtime' must be split in two: 'over' is the down-clue placement signal and 'time' the second piece; read as one word it is pure surface.
explanation.definitionFit: An opera is a staged musical drama, a kind of show.

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: A wicked woman sets out to cause chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: To dishevel is to disarrange or make untidy, especially hair or clothing.

parts.note: Mass is a church service
an acre is a unit of area

explanation.surface: A bloodbath takes place at a motorway service station.
explanation.walkthrough: 'service area' suggests a motorway stop, but it splits into a church service and a measure of land.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean the brutal killing of many people.

definitions.note: the definition is a phrase standing for things fishermen use, a noun

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, hence many
reels spin when line is wound in

explanation.surface: Anglers go out armed with plenty of spinning lures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spinners' looks like fishing lures, but here it means reels.
explanation.definitionFit: Wicker baskets for holding a catch are standard gear among anglers and lobstermen.

clue.text: American business contract with a Peruvian

parts.note: Inc, short for incorporated, marks an American company, the contracted form

explanation.surface: A US firm signs a deal with a man from Lima.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contract' looks like a business deal but means shortened: Incorporated contracts to INC.
explanation.definitionFit: The Inca were the native people who ruled an empire in what is now Peru.

indicators.note: something reformed has been made over, so these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A rehabilitated performance displays the right attitude.
explanation.definitionFit: The characteristic spirit of a community or culture is its guiding character or values.

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five, a small number
to show is to indicate

explanation.surface: Only a handful turn up to demonstrate their backing.
explanation.definitionFit: To vindicate a claim is to justify or uphold it, giving it support.

indicators.note: roadworks rework the surface, so these letters are worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: The roadworks are proceeding as they should.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Road-works' reads as one thing, but 'works' is the anagram signal acting on ROAD to give ORDA.
explanation.definitionFit: To ordain is to decree or command something officially.

parts.note: an ad is a commercial
a mission is a diplomatic office or post

explanation.surface: Getting into an advertising firm's premises.
explanation.definitionFit: Admission means being allowed to enter, entry.

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: the letters may be rearranged, a loose signal that they appear in another form

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece might be rather dated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be' signals a rearrangement of QUITE into TIQUE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something antique is very old, especially a valued piece from a past era.

clue.text: One who's managed to survive in the heat?

definitions.text: One who's managed to survive in the heat?

parts.words: One who's managed to survive in the heat?
parts.note: suggests withstanding hot weather, but a heat is a preliminary race and survivors go through to the next round

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who passes a preliminary round of a competition goes forward to the later stages.

indicators.note: tricked out means dressed up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone was conned into side issues.
explanation.definitionFit: Editions of a newspaper or magazine are its separate issues.

clue.text: Had a vision which put me in great fear

indicators.note: the word me is placed in the middle of the other piece

parts.note: dread is great fear

explanation.surface: Someone saw something that filled them with terror.
explanation.walkthrough: 'which' and 'put' are link words; the surface's terror is the solver's container.
explanation.definitionFit: To have had a vision is to have imagined or seen something in sleep or reverie.

clue.text: Top deck on old ship lacking lights

indicators.note: the top of a down entry word is its first letter

parts.note: Noah's ark is the famous old ship

explanation.surface: The upper deck of an old vessel has no lamps.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhere dark lacks light, so lacking lights describes it.

clue.text: It ensures a good reception for some speakers

definitions.text: It ensures a good reception for some speakers

parts.words: It ensures a good reception for some speakers
parts.note: reads like a host welcoming orators, but the reception is a radio signal and the speakers are loudspeakers

explanation.definitionFit: A rod or wire that picks up broadcast signals gives a good reception to radio sets.

clue.text: His is a searching examination by all accounts

definitions.text: His is a searching examination by all accounts

parts.words: His is a searching examination by all accounts
parts.note: by all accounts suggests reportedly, but here means looking at every set of company books

explanation.definitionFit: An accountant who inspects a firm's books carries out a close financial inspection.

clue.text: Irishman at church for spiritual guidance

parts.note: Sean is a common Irish name
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: An Irishman goes to church seeking guidance from above.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: a séance is a sitting where spirits are consulted for guidance.
explanation.definitionFit: A séance is a meeting where people seek messages from spirits of the dead.

clue.text: Bound to be in step — it's greatly appreciated!

indicators.note: the first piece has to be placed in the second

parts.note: a tread is a step on a stair
bound in the sense of certain means sure

explanation.surface: Keeping time in a dance is something much valued.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound' looks like a leap or a tie, but it is the adjective meaning certain, as in 'bound to happen'.
explanation.definitionFit: Treasured means held dear, cherished, valued highly.

clue.text: Do well, getting about ninety fish

indicators.note: the fish word goes about the number letters

parts.note: an eel is a fish
XC is ninety in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: An angler thrives by landing almost a hundred fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To excel is to perform outstandingly, doing very well.

indicators.note: say tells us the word is to be pronounced, not spelt

parts.note: rays are flat fish

explanation.surface: A question about fish farming.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise animals is to rear or breed them.

clue.text: In Australia, football is supreme, OK?

definitions.meaning: Australian ... football is the national code there, often just called ...
to rule is to be supreme

explanation.definitionFit: Australian football is known as Aussie rules, and anything that rules is dominant.

clue.text: Blooming choir make a mess of number

indicators.note: messing something up jumbles it, so these letters are scrambled

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral 500

explanation.surface: Wretched singers botch the piece they are performing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blooming' looks like a mild expletive about the choir; it is the definition, a plant in flower.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchid is a flowering plant, here hinted at by the word for flowering.

clue.text: Horse lost nail, had to be replaced

indicators.note: the letters are replaced in a different order

explanation.surface: A horse threw a shoe nail, so the farrier had to fix it.
explanation.definitionFit: A stallion is an uncastrated male horse.

indicators.note: the letters are changed into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A child asks their mother to pay attention for once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mum' looks like mother; it means quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping mum means saying nothing, so mum is a synonym for quiet.

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet
re means about or concerning
to serve is to suit or be adequate for a purpose

explanation.surface: Say nothing about the lawsuit.
explanation.definitionFit: To preserve something is to keep it safe or maintain it.
